# Thunderbird Calendar create/edit attribute-driven source loader

D324288 review follow-up made `positioned-dialog.mjs` the single source of `DEFAULT_DIALOG_MARGIN`, used an armed `waitForMutationCondition` for the `open` transition, kept the visible Calendar container/fallback selection intact, and restored explicit `event.getAttendees().length > 0`; direct ESLint and diff checks passed, and `test_attendee.js` passed. Runtime Calendar browser coverage was blocked by stale object output. [ad-hoc note]
